zh.title: 漢莎航空退役A340-600 Simple Flying列出剩餘客機
zh.summary: 漢莎退役A340-600；Simple Flying列出剩餘客機
body: 漢莎航空於2026年10月18日正式退役其最後一架空中巴士A340-600客機，結束該機型在該航司超過二十年的商業運營。
航空媒體Simple Flying同日發布專文，提供全球仍保有載客服務A340機型的機場與航司清單，供愛好者參考觀賞。
早前報導指出，漢莎於10月12日已宣佈將安排最後一次跨大西洋飛行以完成A340-600退役程序；該指南涵蓋多家航空公司與主要樞紐，幫助飛機攝影師規劃拍攝行程。

en.title: Lufthansa retires A340-600; Simple Flying lists remaining passenger A340s
en.summary: Lufthansa retires A340-600; Simple Flying guide shows remaining passenger A340s
body: Lufthansa officially retired its last Airbus A340-600 on 18 October 2026, ending more than two decades of commercial operation of the type with the airline.

On the same day, aviation outlet Simple Flying published a guide listing the airports and carriers worldwide that still operate passenger A340 aircraft, giving spotters a reference for remaining sightings.

Earlier reports indicated that Lufthansa had announced on 12 October a final transatlantic flight to complete the A340-600 retirement process; the guide covers multiple airlines and major hubs to help photographers plan their shoots.
